name: ambition
quote: I bowl every day working towards that perfect game.
description: A strong desire to achieve a particular goal someday with a specific plan to reach it.

variations.name: selfish ambition
variations.description: If the plan to reach the goal will negatively affect others, they may see it as selfish.
examples: He's stepped on a lot of toes in his career.

variations.name: long-term ambition
variations.description: A desire that is going to take many years of consistent effort to achieve.

commentaries.quote: A man's worth is no greater than his ambitions.

There are lots of inspiring quotes about ambition from lots of great people. But bad people have ambitions too. It may be worth occasionally weighing the price of your action plan against the anticipated outcome.
Ambition is the path to success. Persistence is the vehicle you arrive in.

conditions: A strong desire to achieve a particular goal someday.
A specific plan to reach that goal.
